title: Mexican Cobbler
description: A classic mexican dessert made with a crispy crust and a sweet, sugar-rich topping.

ingredients.name: 1 (14.1 oz) package of Mexican cornbread mix

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cornbread mix, granulated sugar, and melted butter. Mix until well combined.
Fold in the blackberries and chopped pecans (if using).
Pour the mixture into a greased 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix the brown sugar and a pinch of cinnamon. Sprinkle over the top of the cobbler.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the cobbler is golden brown and the fruit is bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
